d: Short, messy silver-white hair with choppy bangs is topped by a black headband with white text. The eyes are a sharp gold, set into a youthful, mature face. The build is lean and athletic, wearing a sleeveless white ribbed undershirt beneath a black and orange tactical vest, paired with baggy charcoal grey cargo pants and heavy black and orange mechanical boots. A metallic prosthetic right arm is visible from the shoulder down, and the character holds a massive, rectangular black and orange mechanical shield.
